name: as_low_grid
note: stationary A-S target projected to 5 half-spread levels; inventory sign selects skew

name: as_high_grid
note: stationary A-S target projected to 5 half-spread levels; inventory sign selects skew

name: queue_aware
rule: select 2/3/6 bps half-spread from mean best-level displayed depth; skew toward the thinner side

name: noisy_grid
rule: per step choose a uniformly random currently valid action with probability p; otherwise use base

name: flow_skew
rule: buy pressure -> bid-lean; sell pressure -> ask-lean; neutral -> balanced; inventory extreme overrides signal

name: toxicity_gate
rule: stand aside in high volatility unless inventory requires skew; BER selects protective skew
